layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Use py-20 lg:py-32 for major sections, gap-8 to gap-12 for bento grids.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_rules: Mix tall cards (col-span-4 row-span-2), hero blocks (col-span-8), and metric indicators (col-span-4) with glassmorphism or 1px subtle borders.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Internal padding p-6 to p-10 on all cards and containers to eliminate border collisions.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_requirement: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, cards, and form elements MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='nav-home-link', data-testid='contact-submit-button').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.header_navigation: Header must NEVER be fully transparent. Use glassmorphic backdrop-blur-md bg-[#030712]/90 with a crisp cyan bottom border border-cyan-500/20. Ensure desktop links are always visible.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_states: Hover states must explicitly declare text colors, e.g., hover:bg-cyan-500/10 hover:text-cyan-400 hover:border-cyan-400/40.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_fake_metrics: Do NOT include fake customer logos, fabricated client metrics, or fake testimonials. Focus on technical architecture capabilities, code samples, interactive diagrams, and business value propositions.
